qualification.status: Typed SDF scalar evaluation and modeling failures implemented and locally qualified; standalone-grid extraction supplied by Hypermesh to the modeling sampler.
owners: CSGRS shared sampled-field modeling and diagnostics
qualification.domain: Real callbacks and retained SdfExpr values over rectangular sample grids, preserving valid formulas and fixture resolutions. The output is the sampled Surface Nets level-surface proposal; numerical certainty does not establish closed topology or continuous-field fidelity. Strict construction branches and selected-policy extraction have separate roles.
qualification.migration: solid::sdf, sdf_with_diagnostics, sdf_expr and sdf_expr_with_diagnostics now return Result and delegate to the shared context sampler. Expression failures retain sample index and SdfEvaluationError including native scalar source. Added sdf_expr_with_diagnostics_and_context. Resolution below two now fails instead of clamping; diagnostics fail when requested signs/extrema cannot be decided. The modeling sampler uses the new shared Hypermesh surface_nets_standalone entry point, including final-layer faces whenever all four incident cells are present. The existing native surface_nets entry point retains its documented chunk ownership convention. This explicitly migrates modeling output rather than claiming unchanged artifacts. Hypersdf classification and preview keep their existing report contracts; the legacy primitive scalar_value Option explicitly discards the new fallible method's errors.
semantic_evidence: Eight reproduced SDF failures distinguish invalid domains, undecided scalar branches/samples, capacity overflow and invalid resolution from successful empty geometry.

Arithmetic failure after two successful samples preserves grid index [2,0,0] and the native SqrtNegative cause through Error::source. Subsequent constant-field sampling, union from empty and subtraction to empty succeed.
Independently derived scalar values cover all eight native primitives, expression composition, boundaries, invalid parameters and unresolved domains/branches.

Exact rational plane positions, sample counts and extrema are checked independently of wrapper agreement. Native planes crossing first/last layers on all three axes have independently known unit oriented area and exact transverse coordinates.

Strict/approximate/strict sequences retain local certainty: approximate sample evidence does not authorize approximate expression branches or enter strict preview sign buckets. Selecting an approximate policy for a known constant still yields Certified.
Existing sampled spheres, extreme exact scalar magnitudes, closed-mesh validation, downstream Boolean use and all three TPMS solid fixtures retain their original resolutions and pass.
qualification.trials: baseline-v1 preparation failed before tests; baseline-v2 failed all eight regressions at a8ca70322 plus original native changes. Candidate v1/v2 compile failures are retained. Candidate v3 exposed missing final-layer plane faces in the modeling API despite successful error tests. Native chunk ownership was subsequently identified as deliberate and retained; the modeling layer now selects standalone extraction. Candidate v4 passed focused runtime checks but strict Clippy rejected test loop style. Native v1 stopped on pre-existing nested fuzz formatting drift; formatting-only fixes were applied. Native v2 passed runtime and root lint checks but stopped on a pre-existing nested fuzz loop lint. Native v3 fixes that lint and qualifies the final source, including the explicit native chunk/standalone split.
qualification.resources: Checked primary sample, coordinate and diagnostic-preview reservations report capacity/allocation failures. Scalar expression work, native extraction and secondary preview allocations still lack internal total-work, heap-byte and cancellation limits. Each validation command uses external 1800-second wall containment. No performance improvement or bounded execution is claimed.
limitations: Eight existing ignored cases remain: one root rendering case and seven Hypermesh external-fixture/manual scale or memory tests. Counts across feature configurations overlap.

The lossy Hypersdf preview backend retains its chunk boundary convention and may omit final-layer faces or withhold unknown-sign samples accepted by approximate meshing. It remains PreviewOnly and never replaces the authoritative native mesh.
Examples and benchmark consumers are compiled with strict all-target Clippy; no benchmark timing or generated rendering claim is made. Fuzz targets are compiled and linted, not fuzzed for a duration.

SDF Rust APIs are not exposed by the current C/Go/Python/WASM bindings. FFI unit tests and all-target compilation pass, but live binding consumers were not rerun for this Rust/API and native-grid change.
The complete workflow matrix, sanitizers, clean external package/release/MSRV validation and performance comparison remain open.

Separate metaball fallbacks and approximation policy, other modeling failure migrations, end-to-end provenance, resource bounds, ordinary strict-workflow completion and prior scalar/native admission gaps remain open.
